title: Assessment durability walkthrough
scope: Selected target design; complete implementation and qualification pending. Paused action policy remains unresolved.

steps.title: Client requests an assessment
steps.description: The client submits a registered assessment job for https://github.com/somewhere/main.git and supplies arguments.
steps.handoff: Client request -> registered assessment gateway.
steps.persistence: Retain the authorized job inputs through the admitted start path. This request is not permission for arbitrary tools.
steps.refusal: No direct Claude, shell or Context Mode entrance. Client submission deduplication must reconcile one logical job.
steps.qualification: Transport/job API binding remains to be implemented and qualified.

steps.title: Gateway authenticates and authorizes
steps.description: Establish the client identity and authorize the assessment package, repository access, actions and report destination.
steps.handoff: Authenticated caller -> scoped job policy -> trusted internal request.
steps.persistence: Bind namespace, job, lineage/resource and admitted configuration. A certificate alone does not grant an action.
steps.refusal: Refuse unauthorized or cross-client requests. Never archive repository credentials in a prompt or workspace checkpoint.
steps.qualification: IdentityPolicy and gateway enforcement need runtime proof.

steps.title: Pin repository, arguments and package
steps.description: Resolve moving repository references to an exact commit. Validate the assessment package, arguments, metadata, tools, permissions and script dependencies.
steps.handoff: Authorized job -> fixed preparation inputs.
steps.persistence: Retain the exact input revision, argument identity, package hash and policy/runtime identities before dependent execution.
steps.refusal: Refuse unsupported package capabilities or conflicting inputs. SKILL.md, scripts and references remain; universal unchanged compatibility is not promised.
steps.qualification: Exact repository input and request deduplication API contracts still require implementation.

steps.title: Establish the original lineage
steps.description: The trusted starter supplies the lineage once in immutable Workflow input. Continue-As-New and supported reset preserve it.
steps.handoff: Starter -> Session input -> original identity across all handoffs.
steps.persistence: The reset draft proposes conditional reservation of lineage, job and input binding outside Workflow code. UUID randomness alone is not uniqueness enforcement.
steps.refusal: A lost start reply reconciles the same job. Missing lineage, collision or changed binding refuses; reset cannot mint a new lineage.
steps.qualification: The reservation mechanism is an unreviewed proposal. The pause left DSR-0.8 action policy unresolved.

steps.title: Start the Temporal Session Workflow
steps.description: The Session coordinates job progress, accepted checkpoint head, human decisions and parked state.
steps.handoff: Workflow commands / accepted history -> reconstructable Session state.
steps.persistence: Temporal retains orchestration history. The Session records exact checkpoint references and accepted predecessor, while the checkpoint service holds the large bytes.
steps.refusal: A Query or Search Attribute is discovery only. Neither an uploaded object nor a status stream advances the accepted head.
steps.qualification: Retained Phase 1 proof is bounded. The full store/authority/native composition remains unqualified.

steps.title: Create and identify execution
steps.description: The external controller creates an isolated execution incarnation and records its exact resource and launch identity.
steps.handoff: Controller lifecycle request -> independently identified execution.
steps.persistence: Bind the incarnation before materialization. Initial services and execution containers share one trusted host; these columns are not five physical hosts.
steps.refusal: Create acknowledgement is not complete materialization. Reconcile lost create replies; jobs receive no controller socket or administration keys.
steps.qualification: Built controller/image/host identities and actual containment/termination require qualification.

steps.title: Prepare or restore the workspace
steps.description: Prepare the admitted package and exact repository input, or restore an existing exact accepted native/workspace pair.
steps.handoff: Authorized immutable inputs -> validated workspace and materialization receipt.
steps.persistence: Preserve supported hidden/deleted/executable/link metadata, package/policy/runtime identities and original pending references. Authorize before loading or decrypting.
steps.refusal: Missing accepted bytes is not new bootstrap. Partial claims, stale pairs, traversal, unsupported metadata or mismatched policy refuse.
steps.qualification: DSR-2.1 remains OPEN. Model-free preparation proof does not qualify native recovery.

steps.title: Establish the runner and SDK controls
steps.description: Application -> governed project runner -> Claude Agent SDK -> Claude Code. Bind callbacks and controlled settings before engine startup.
steps.handoff: SDK messages and permission/hook callbacks -> runner; accepted prompts/results/control -> SDK.
steps.persistence: Receive complete native messages, bind the package/policy and establish PreToolUse capture, deny-only permission backstop and original-pending recovery callback.
steps.refusal: Missing required prevention must refuse effects. Interrupt return or disconnect is not whole-process termination evidence.
steps.qualification: Integration lock SDK 0.2.154 is distinct from retained proof SDK 0.2.162 / CLI 2.1.274. Exact callback wiring must be admitted.

steps.title: Optional inner Claude Mods layer
steps.description: An approved Mod could observe/intercept supported engine events or assist exact native projection. Native skill loading does not require it.
steps.handoff: Supported inner event/result seam <-> governed outer runner adapter.
steps.persistence: A Mod event, local store or successful hook call is not protected storage acknowledgement or Session acceptance. No undocumented Mod-to-runner channel is assumed.
steps.refusal: Missing, failed or skipped required interception/projection needs independent refusal. A Mod never owns head acceptance, dispatch or physical lifecycle.
steps.qualification: Announced minimum CLI 2.1.287 is a separate unqualified lane. Headless loading, ordering and communication need proof.

steps.title: Claude reads and applies the skill
steps.description: Claude owns its agent loop and native skill loading. Confined Read/Grep/Glob may repeat. Selected Context Mode processes authorized immutable artifacts.
steps.handoff: Prompt + admitted skill -> native reads and proposed next call.
steps.persistence: Retain authoritative native records and any exact accepted projection separately from disposable indexes. Rebuilding search cannot recreate accepted model bytes.
steps.refusal: Deny unsupported tools and escapes. Restricted Code Mode/harness and positive child/parallel remain selected requirements, with present denial until qualification.
steps.qualification: An assessment package needing child agents cannot assume support from generic harness concurrency.

steps.title: Capture and defer the original tool call
steps.description: Claude proposes a tool such as Bash. PreToolUse captures exact native call ID, name and canonical input and holds execution.
steps.handoff: Native tool proposal -> captured pending slot -> runner.
steps.persistence: This is intent observation, not durable intent admission. The independently enforced permission backstop must prevent native effects when the hook supplies no decision.
steps.refusal: Do not let the native engine execute Bash directly. Different calls after pause refuse; the returned pending request must match the captured identity.
steps.qualification: The complete durable handoff still needs sealing, store ACK, Session acceptance and Entity scheduling.

steps.title: Quiesce and seal pending state
steps.description: Drain relevant native/workspace writers and independently confirm termination of the owned execution before sealing, while preserving required sole-readable bytes. Seal exact conversation prefix, pending identity and matching workspace.
steps.handoff: Captured original call -> sealed immutable native/workspace checkpoint candidate.
steps.persistence: Bind every required digest, accepted predecessor, package/policy/runtime, lineage/ordinal and lifecycle identity. Sole-readable bytes need preservation before destructive cleanup.
steps.refusal: A mutable suffix, local marker or Mod-held call is not an accepted checkpoint. Do not schedule an effect yet.
steps.qualification: Concrete quiescence, sealing and adapter mapping are unimplemented requirements. Preserve the existing original-pending guard.

steps.title: Persist immutable checkpoint objects
steps.description: The trusted publisher stores complete exact encrypted objects and metadata under immutable identities. The scoped broker authorizes before retrieval/decryption.
steps.handoff: Sealed bytes -> protected object publication -> durable acknowledgement.
steps.persistence: The local binding must persist required file contents and containing directory before ACK. Retain plaintext and stored-byte digests plus exact versions/key context.
steps.refusal: Lost ACK reconciles the same object and original bytes. Neither Moto nor a Docker volume name alone establishes acknowledged durability.
steps.qualification: The service binding and SDK reader-scope propagation remain unimplemented. Scope policy and broker selection are already approved.

steps.title: Accept the pending checkpoint head
steps.description: Validate the complete matching pair and conditionally advance from the expected predecessor only after all required object ACKs.
steps.handoff: Acknowledged checkpoint candidate -> committed Session accepted head.
steps.persistence: Temporal head acceptance binds exact native/workspace/pending identity. There is no transaction across Temporal and the object store.
steps.refusal: An orphan upload cannot dispatch. Lost head replies inspect the same requested acceptance; never select uploaded latest or replace bytes.
steps.qualification: Conditional head/receipt fault cases require meaningful implementation and execution evidence.

steps.title: Record original intent and schedule once
steps.description: The Entity validates accepted pending state and retains the original logical call binding before scheduling the nonrepeatable effect.
steps.handoff: Accepted original pending call -> retained Entity intent -> one scheduling decision.
steps.persistence: Retain lineage, original ordinal/key/input digest, accepted checkpoint and execution binding outside restorable files and outer Session reset.
steps.refusal: Duplicates or lost replies return original status/result, never another spawn permit. Missing/regressed authority parks; reset/delete/recreation/rollback is denied.
steps.qualification: Entity and local guard composition needs DSR-2.2/3.5 proof. Intent can prevent duplicates without proving whether an effect actually happened.

steps.title: Run the governed effect
steps.description: Only the Entity-scheduled admitted wrapper performs Bash. Protected local claims add defense before spawn; Bash uses one attempt.
steps.handoff: Retained dispatch -> admitted wrapper -> isolated command execution.
steps.persistence: Validate original identity, policy and exact execution. Preserve key/ordinal claims outside effect-writable workspace.
steps.refusal: There is no direct SDK-to-effects bypass. Local restore cannot recreate permission. Timeout/cancellation does not prove nonexecution.
steps.qualification: Runtime prevention, descendant containment and native differential behavior are pending at their owners.

steps.title: Capture result and required postimage
steps.description: Capture exact original status/error/native metadata, output artifacts and required workspace postimage after the effect.
steps.handoff: Executed command -> original outcome bytes and postimage awaiting publication.
steps.persistence: The external effect may already have happened while completion bytes are still local or incomplete. Retained intent prevents redispatch but cannot fabricate those bytes.
steps.refusal: Never rerun Bash to learn its outcome or recover output. Missing result/postimage remains uncertain even if the process is gone.
steps.qualification: This gap is not closed by a post-tool event or Mod callback. Recovery must inspect the original state or park.

steps.title: Persist original completion
steps.description: Publish the original result, required postimage and selected accepted projection under the original identity. Reconcile a lost publication reply against the same objects. The separate Temporal node 18b validates and accepts completion.
steps.handoff: Original result/postimage -> complete acknowledged protected objects -> Session acceptance at 18b.
steps.persistence: Storage preserves exact original raw bytes, native status/metadata, required postimage and selected projection. It returns exact identity and durable acknowledgement; it cannot advance the accepted head.
steps.refusal: Lost reply with surviving exact bytes reconciles. Missing required outcome/projection parks. Lost acknowledged accepted bytes is durability FAIL.
steps.qualification: The storage binding and completion-pair tests remain pending. This stage owns byte publication, not Session acceptance.

steps.title: Deliver the accepted native result
steps.description: After independently confirmed effect teardown, restore the exact original native pending state and conditionally append the accepted result at the expected head after all state and authority barriers pass.
steps.handoff: Accepted original completion -> SDK native pending call -> next model continuation.
steps.persistence: Preserve native call ID, exact result/status/error metadata, required workspace and accepted projection. No regenerated request or new effect identity.
steps.refusal: Refuse changed heads, malformed mapping, unsupported fork/attempt or missing required state. A generic injected result is not native recovery proof.
steps.qualification: The retained serial lane exists; distributed composition, projection and harness mapping remain separate qualification.

steps.title: Repeat the cycle or wait for a human
steps.description: A next admitted segment repeats the effect cycle. A native question yields a durable decision identity; the Session waits while the gateway obtains an authorized signed answer.
steps.handoff: Native question -> durable Session wait -> signed original answer -> native delivery.
steps.persistence: Retain original decision/call/lineage, deadlines, accepted answers and unapplied actions across Continue-As-New. SDK callbacks do not hold an Activity indefinitely for a person.
steps.refusal: Cancellation wins; conflicting, late, unsigned or substituted decisions refuse. Human permission does not supply an unknown effect result.
steps.qualification: Signed gateway, handover/concurrency proof and positive child/parallel are pending. No whole-model-response or token escrow promise is selected.

steps.title: Recover against independent barriers
steps.description: Consult Session accepted head, exact stored bytes, original Entity intent/outcome and independent exact-incarnation terminal evidence.
steps.handoff: Failure/reset -> original-state reconciliation -> exact native recovery OR park.
steps.persistence: Reset preserves lineage, ordinal and original call identity. Continue-As-New is a deliberate handover. A changed claim Run ID alone does not distinguish them.
steps.refusal: No replacement before verified prior termination. No authority recreation or claim clearing. An already issued external request needs its own outcome reconciliation.
steps.qualification: Initial local container proof comes first. Host/disk loss on another host and live partition remain mandatory before portable admission. DSR-0.8 action choice remains unresolved.

steps.title: Accept and deliver the final report
steps.description: Persist the final assessment report and required provenance under the job identity before declaring completion. Return only the authenticated client's approved domain report.
steps.handoff: Accepted report -> gateway authorization -> client delivery.
steps.persistence: Bind the delivered report to retained output. A streamed progress event or live listener is not final-output authority.
steps.refusal: No native trajectories, raw indexes, checkpoints or recovery keys go to the client unless separately authorized. A lost delivery reply must not rerun assessment effects.
steps.qualification: Exact public job/output API and delivery deduplication need implementation. This diagram shows required behavior, not a shipped endpoint.

steps.title: Terminate execution and retain references
steps.description: Confirm exact execution teardown. Remove only proven unreferenced objects after the admitted horizon; Context Mode indexes remain disposable.
steps.handoff: Terminal execution evidence -> reference-safe cleanup and retained recovery state.
steps.persistence: Synthetic retention is at least seven days and extends through every live/parked/reset/replay reference, including objects, keys and authority.
steps.refusal: Unknown retention keeps state. Do not erase sole-readable unresolved postimages or treat Namespace expiry as deletion permission.
steps.qualification: Production customer policy remains separate. DSR-4.2/5.4 conformance and portable failure proof are OPEN.

steps.title: Park or durability failure
steps.description: Preserve the original call and concrete failure cause. A safe refusal can prevent repeated execution while the promised data durability still fails.
steps.handoff: Unverified authority/death or missing required outcome -> park. Lost acknowledged accepted bytes -> durability FAIL.
steps.persistence: Keep original intent, accepted references and unresolved evidence. Do not mark uncertainty NOT_RUN.
steps.refusal: No redo, release_claim, fresh ordinal/lineage escape or fabricated native result. The abort-only action proposal was not approved.
steps.qualification: This artifact does not decide DSR-0.8's remaining action policy.

steps.title: Client receives the authorized report
steps.description: The client obtains its retained domain report through the authenticated registered-job service.
steps.handoff: Gateway -> authorized original job recipient.
steps.persistence: The final report remains bound to accepted output; the response itself does not create a new outcome.
steps.refusal: Clients do not gain direct Context Mode APIs, unrestricted analysis execution, native trajectories or recovery keys.
steps.qualification: Reader enforcement and production admission still require proof.

steps.title: Session accepts the original completion
steps.description: This is the second half of numbered step 18. After storage acknowledges complete objects, the Session validates their exact relationship to the original pending call and dispatch, then conditionally advances the accepted head.
steps.handoff: Acknowledged original result/postimage/projection -> Temporal Session acceptance -> native result delivery at 19.
steps.persistence: Temporal owns the accepted completion identity and expected predecessor. The checkpoint service holds bytes; it cannot accept the checkpoint itself.
steps.refusal: Missing, conflicting or mismatched result/postimage/pending relationships refuse or park. Lost head replies reconcile the same acceptance; no transaction across stores is claimed.
steps.qualification: Completion-head acceptance and fault tests are unimplemented requirements. This node exists to keep ownership visible on the main path.
